snippet.title: Lunarium - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets. Lunarium will be available on PC in May 2026.
